name: Apollo Diversified Credit Securitize Fund
oneLiner: ACRED is a tokenized, NAV-accreting feeder share into Apollo's diversified private credit fund, administered by Securitize for qualified purchasers.
collateral: Feeder share into Apollo Diversified Credit Fund, a multi-strategy private credit portfolio including direct lending, structured credit, performing credit, and dislocated credit; administered by Securitize
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting ERC-4626 fund share token; subscription and redemption are institutional-only at monthly fund NAV through Securitize Markets, with an on-demand liquidity pool sized up to roughly 5% of NAV; RedStone publishes the NAV oracle used by integrations

proofOfReserves.provider: Securitize / Apollo (NAV statements published per fund cadence)

jurisdiction.license: Securitize-administered feeder; access restricted to qualified purchasers

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Securitize operates ACRED with permissioned token transfers restricted to KYC-onboarded qualified purchasers and retains transfer-agent freeze and burn authority on behalf of Apollo.

mintAuthority.summary: ACRED's reviewed Ethereum Securitize DSToken surface exposes issueTokens functions and the Ethereum owner resolves to an EOA; Aptos, Solana, Avalanche, Ink, and Polygon routes remain unresolved.

controls.label: ACRED Securitize DSToken issuance surface
controls.evidence: Ethereum lane reads returned implementation 0xfc8a9000c161e3c6e073e967107ce926a44a06e2 and owner() = 0x59c1eAcEc450c57Dcb9b8725d0F96635C2b676Ee. Partial Sourcify DSToken source exposes issueTokens, issueTokensCustom, issueTokensWithMultipleLocks, and issueTokensWithNoCompliance issuance functions.

controls.label: ACRED token owner
controls.evidence: Lane code read returned no contract bytecode for this owner, so no on-chain multisig threshold or Safe policy was verified.

review.evidence: Securitize materials and Ethereum DSToken source/direct reads identify an issuer-operated issueTokens path and EOA owner for the reviewed Ethereum deployment.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve Aptos, Solana, Avalanche, Ink, and Polygon token or bridge authorities before claiming multichain completeness.

notices.title: Private credit, not Treasuries
notices.message: ACRED is a feeder into Apollo Diversified Credit Fund, which holds direct lending and structured credit positions. Risk profile is medium-to-high and closer to syrupUSDC than to BUIDL or BENJI. Token transfers are permissioned and redemption is monthly at NAV via Securitize Markets, with an on-demand pool sized to ~5% of NAV. Pharos tracks the Ethereum, Aptos, Avalanche, Ink, Polygon, and Solana deployments; the Sei issuance via Wormhole is not yet integrated.
